name: logo-strip
title: Logo strip
description: A single quiet row of customer marks with a short lead-in on the left, made to sit right under a hero without competing with it.
docs: Pass title, logos (the Logo type of LogoCloud: name, mark, href) and an optional more ({ label, href }) that sits under the lead-in. Marks are drawn at one height in the muted text colour; a linked mark comes to full strength on hover and has a focus ring, and a picture mark is greyed and dimmed. Every mark carries its name for screen readers. The strip answers to its own width, not the window: from 56rem, where six marks fit, the lead-in sits on the left and the marks spread across one row; narrower, the marks sit three to a row (two under 18rem), beside the lead-in down to 42rem and under it below that, so six make two even rows. Marks never shrink to an unreadable size. Put it directly under a hero.
